title: THC Advanced Canopy, Flowering and Reproductive Biology Certificate
publicDesignation: THC Advanced Canopy, Flowering and Reproductive Biology Certificate

assessmentModel.knowledgeAssessment: Randomized advanced canopy, flowering and reproductive-biology assessment mapped to six course objectives; credential use remains blocked until bank depth, review, pilot evidence and standard-setting are complete.
assessmentModel.retakePolicy: Maximum attempts and cooldown must follow the current approved course assessment configuration once validation is complete.
assessmentModel.completionEvidence: Course completion and final-assessment result must be retained in the Academy learner record.
assessmentModel.performanceEvidence: The canopy/flowering form of the required Technician II performance review must be passed with no critical errors and verified evidence artifacts.

limitations: Does not authorize unrestricted environmental-program redesign, unsupported genetic/reproductive diagnosis or work outside assigned workplace authority.
Does not replace employer procedures, safety requirements or jurisdiction-specific rules.
Documents Academy educational/workforce achievement and is not an independent personnel certification or government license.
